alt: Two vertical chains are shown. Application runs on an agent harness, which wraps a foundation model bounded by working state. A large task requires a reasoning horizon that may exceed available working state and contribute to churn. A dashed correspondence connects bounded and available working state, labeled Same working state. A footer defines a fleet as multiple agents on a shared engineering system.
